name: Mongo Ridge (Southwest Buttress)
approach: The approach is identical to the standard East Peak route for its first 12+ miles, then continues much farther. From the Ross Dam Trailhead at Happy Flats on SR 20 (~milepost 134, about 2,100 ft), walk about 1 mile down to the Ross Lake water taxi dock and cross to Big Beaver Landing. From there follow the Big Beaver Creek Trail 11.5 miles up-valley (flat, well-graded, ~5 hours), passing Luna Camp at roughly the 4.7-hour mark. About 29 minutes past Luna Camp, leave the trail at a large (~15-inch) log crossing of Big Beaver Creek and turn up the Access Creek drainage. This is a genuine bushwhack: roughly 1 mile and 1,900 ft of gain (2,400 ft to 4,300 ft) through valley-bottom devil's club, a mid-height creek crossing near 3,800 ft where the brush pinches down to the water, then huckleberry brush and talus for the final half-mile into Access Basin. From the basin, climb a long, steep, grungy scree chute gaining ~1,800 ft to 6,100-ft Access Col — expect loose footing and, in season, hot afternoon sun with no shade. From Access Col, most Mongo Ridge parties do not stop at Luna Pass but instead continue over/around the connecting terrain and up the Southeast Glacier route to the summit of East Fury (see the Southeast Glaciers route for that terrain in detail: heather/talus traverse, Northeast Ridge, a rocky-rib traverse, and the crevassed Southeast Glacier with a ~7,900-ft bergschrund). From East Fury's summit, descend north along the connecting ridge and down to the base of the Southwest Buttress (Mongo Ridge) proper to rack up — this backdoor approach avoids the historically brutal, brush-choked Goodell Creek approach that early parties used to reach the ridge's true toe. Expect this whole approach, camp to base of technical climbing, to take a long day or two on its own; most parties treat it as a multi-day expedition with a camp at Luna Pass or on the connecting ridge.

waypoints.name: Ross Dam Trailhead (SR-20)
waypoints.note: Same trailhead used for all Northern Pickets objectives (Fury, Challenger, Luna Peak) via boat taxi or ~7mi walk around Ross Lake to Big Beaver Trailhead, then Big Beaver Trail + off-trail Access Creek approach to Luna Col/East Fury;
waypoints.directions: From Marblemount, drive SR-20 east past Newhalem and Diablo to the Ross Dam Trailhead parking lot near milepost 134, about 14 miles east of Newhalem, at roughly 2,100 ft. The trail drops about a mile to Ross Lake, where the Ross Lake Resort water taxi to Big Beaver Landing must be reserved in advance, and overnight stays in the park need a backcountry permit.
